subject: planner, executor: enhance the index join's choice (#51128)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. Planner change generalizes IndexJoin inner-child pattern extraction to support chained Projection/Selection/UnionScan (gated by `tidb_enable_inl_join_inner_multi_pattern` for Projection/Selection), reconstructs wrapped physical inner plans accordingly, and fixes Projection schema propagation via `physicalProj.SetSchema(proj.schema)`. Executor change makes IndexJoin inner Projection building recursive (supporting wrapped children) and properly propagates `canReorderHandles`. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics/consistency/compatibility/concurrency/session-runtime issues found in the touched planner/executor paths.
